options.name: api_port
options.description: Port for the Technitium DNS API. Defaults to 5380

options.name: api_token
options.description: API token for authenticating with the Technitium DNS API

options.name: api_url
options.description: Base URL for the Technitium DNS API

options.name: clientIdentifier
options.description: The client identifier for the lease Either hardwareAddress or clientIdentifier must be specified

options.name: hardwareAddress
options.description: The MAC address of the device bearing the lease Either hardwareAddress or clientIdentifier must be specified

options.name: name
options.description: The name of the DHCP scope containing the lease

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: Whether to validate SSL certificates when making API requests
